correctness.rationale: Three conditional pair-correlation equations were derived from every independent simultaneous neighbor choice. The denominators D_v,D_w exceed zero for 0<q<1, the exact identity for v-w has nonnegative factors for s>=2, and H=1-w+(s-1)(v-w)>0. The reduced fixed point is a strict contraction, proving unique monotone hub correlations, positive inversion denominators and graph reconstruction. Ergodicity proves almost-sure empirical convergence. An independent full-pair-state rational solver checked 33 finite parameter cases and returned VERIFY_OK; finite checks are supplementary, not a substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: The theorem directly resolves the local-to-global graph-identification question for all finite rooted clique bouquets under synchronous noisy voting at arbitrary nondegenerate known noise. It identifies both independent graph parameters using just two measurable temporal correlations and exactly isolates the star obstruction, going substantially beyond a special-case count, algebraic substitution, or routine isolated computation.
